rulesPanelEnglish.rulesCxf5: With several coins, a round where too few coins survive pays back only part of your stake: it is a profit only when the survivors times each coin's payout is more than the number of coins.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesCxf1: Pick a side, how many flips in a row (1 to 10) and how many coins (1 to 10). With more than one flip you can call each flip; every coin must land the whole pattern.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesCxf2: The coins flip together, one flip at a time. A coin that misses drops out; a coin that lands every flip survives.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesCxf3: Your stake is split evenly across the coins. Each surviving coin pays its share at 0.99 × 2ⁿ for n flips, and the round pays the sum. One coin is the classic flips in a row.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesCxfEdge: Every coin is a 99% bet, so every combination of flips and coins returns at most 99% over the long run, a 1% house edge. With 7 coins the payout is rounded down to four decimals, so it returns a hair less.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesPayNote: A coin survives when it lands every flip as called. Each survivor pays its share of the stake at this multiplier, and the round pays the sum.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesMulti1: Pick a side and how many coins to toss, 2 to 10. Your stake is split evenly across the coins.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesMulti2: Every coin that lands your side pays its share at 1.98×, and the round pays the sum: 7 of 10 coins pays 1.386×.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesMulti3: Below the break-even you get part of your stake back; above it you profit. Every coin landing pays 1.98×.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesMultiEdge: Each coin is an even-money bet at 99%, so a round returns at most 99% (98.995% at 7 coins, where the payout is rounded down).
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesStreak1: Pick Heads or Tails and how many flips in a row, 1 to 10. With more than one flip you can call each flip yourself.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesStreak2: The coins flip one after another. You win only if every flip lands as called.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesStreak3: A win pays 0.99 × 2ⁿ for n flips: 1.98× for one, up to 1,013.76× for ten.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesCoins1: Pick a side, how many coins flip at once (1 to 10), and how many of them must land your side.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesCoins2: All coins flip together. You win if at least that many land your side; the bar under the coins counts them.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesCoins3: A win pays 0.99 × 2ⁿ ÷ S, where S is the number of ways at least your target can land. The fewer you need, the smaller the payout.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesEdge1: Every bet returns at most 99% over the long run, a 1% house edge: the multiplier is the fair odds times 0.99, rounded down to four decimals.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesEdge2: The win chance is capped at 98%, so the smallest target is 2 at 6–8 coins and 3 at 9–10 coins.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesSpeed1: Use the speed control in the game toolbar: Normal, Fast or Turbo. Speed changes the animation, not the result.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesAuto1: Autobet repeats your bet with your stops and on-win / on-loss rules; ⚡ Instant settles a run at once and draws it as a line.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesMaxWin: The maximum win on one bet is {cap}.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesFair1: Each flip comes from an HMAC-SHA256 stream keyed with the server seed over your client seed and the bet number; flip i reads draw i, and the top bit of the draw picks the side.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesFair2: The server seed is committed by its hash before you bet and revealed when you rotate it, so no result can be changed after the fact.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesFair3: Open Provably Fair to verify any round flip by flip.
rulesPanelEnglish.rulesMaxWinCap: Most a spin can win above its stake: {cap}.
